## [You won’t receive your purchases](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6668dcb10f60bacfed6be0ab)
My husband and I ordered a rug that never arrived. Lulu and Georgia has no customer service except for an answering machine that no one ever calls back after leaving a message. My husband emailed and we got a ghost of a response with no solution. We will have to dispute the charge in our cc. So sad as they have nice things on the website.

June 11, 2024
